requirements.quote: Specifications are intended to outline the general requirements, standards of performance, specific equipment characteristics, standards of materials and manufacturing, factory and/or on-site tests and warranty related to furnishing of equipment under these specifications.
requirements.text: Specifications outline requirements, standards, tests, and warranty for equipment.

requirements.quote: Specifications provide the Manufacturer with minimum standards of quality for components and materials to be used in the manufacture of equipment. All materials and components shall be first quality, newly manufactured, from manufacture’s or Manufacturer’s stock.
requirements.text: Manufacturer must meet minimum quality standards for components and materials.

requirements.quote: Correspondence with the Owner shall be addressed to Mark Montgomery.
requirements.text: All correspondence must be addressed to Mark Montgomery.

requirements.quote: The following work and material will be provided by others unless specifically included in Manufacturer’s proposal. The Owner’s bid evaluation will consider additional work or services offered by the Manufacturer.
requirements.text: Manufacturer's proposal may include additional work or services.

requirements.quote: Termination of all field control and indication of cables.
requirements.text: Field control and cable termination provided by others unless included.

requirements.quote: All required field assembly, including connection of overhead buswork and grounds.
requirements.text: Field assembly and buswork connection provided by others unless included.
